items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We were talking to Eddie Morris yesterday... But you did, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember him going to Chicago.

ctx.x: In the baggage. Yeah. We were talking to Eddie Morris yesterday and he played on excursion but he said there wasn't nothing like a baggage car, he played in a coach, no dancing. But you did, huh?

I don't remember him going to Chicago. No, but there were different, no trips around different places? Well maybe, no, well I probably, they were going a short distance. But you see, like when we stopped in Jackson, Mississippi, and Melford, and them different places like that, you'd be there for quite a while and then we'd break them down. You see?
